title: Device enrollment request/response
description: POST /api/devices/enroll (CSRF-exempt, no user session, no device key yet). Single-use operator-created enrollment token with a short TTL; on success the device moves pending_enrolled -> active and the raw device key is returned exactly once. The root schema accepts either message (oneOf); consumers may also validate #/definitions/request or #/definitions/response directly. Errors outside these two messages use the shared error.schema.json envelope. Frozen for epic #818 / M0.2 #828.

enrollment_token.description: Format bfen_<device_uuid>_<token_urlsafe(32)>. The UUID routes to the pending device row; the secret is verified against the bcrypt-stored enrollment_token_hash. Never logged.

device_key.description: Format bfdk_<device_uuid>_<token_urlsafe(32)>. Raw value returned only in this response (and in rotate-key); at rest only its bcrypt hash exists. Used as X-Bifrost-Key on /api/device/* and as Authorization: Bearer on /ws/connect. The agent must persist it 0600/DACL and never log it.

status.description: Enrollment always lands in active; disabled devices cannot enroll.

enrollment_token_expires_at.description: Echo of the consumed token expiry for operator audit; null after consumption clears the stored hash.
